_what_this_is: The envelope near miss beside this file against a repository that has published nothing, which is the state this repository is in today. It has to pass, and it has to say why it passed. What a drop strands is a peer running a build somebody installed, and there is no such build, so the rule declines rather than asking for an entry against a release nobody can read it next to. The decline is the rule's live behaviour on this mainline, so it is proven here rather than assumed from the refusal.
title: Stop speaking envelope version 1 (#18)
body:
Closes #18.

Version 1 has no peers left that this server has heard from.
